scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. A product acceptance decision is unresolved, so implementation work cannot proceed until the decision is settled. Return only JSON fields: route, writes.
Use $lean-sdlc. Two implementation tasks require writes to the same mutable file at the same time. Return only JSON fields: execution, shared_resource.
Use $lean-sdlc. First size a broad task for independent acceptance. It has no valid independent split, or coordination risk exceeds its value. Return only JSON fields: first_check, outcome, reason.

assertions.equals: no valid independent split or coordination risk exceeds value

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. A broad task has valid independent tasks, but shared resources or low elapsed-time savings block parallel execution. Return only JSON fields: outcome, reason.

assertions.equals: independent acceptance exists, but shared resources or low savings require serial execution

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. A broad task has valid independent tasks and passes the parallel risk-benefit check. Return only JSON fields: outcome, safety, savings.

assertions.equals: meaningful elapsed-time savings after coordination and verification

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. A parallel Engineer spawn is ready after planning, but runtime state may have changed. Return only JSON fields: before_spawn, fallback.
Use $lean-sdlc. A read-only inquiry compares multiple platforms and versions and crosses a shared boundary. Return only JSON fields: role, coverage.

Use $lean-sdlc. The implementation contract, interfaces, acceptance, proof, and paths are settled, with no decision left open. The implementation is substantial enough that delegation has meaningful elapsed-time value. Return only JSON fields: role, decision.

Use $lean-sdlc. In Assisted mode, one understood settled local change is smaller than handoff overhead, with no unresolved decision. Substantial execution and exploration remain delegated to Luna. Return only JSON fields: role, safeguards, substantial_work.

Use $lean-sdlc. Two settled tasks have independent acceptance and disjoint mutable resources. Native capacity permits meaningful elapsed-time savings for one read-only child. Return only JSON fields: engineers, optional_child, descendants, resource_rule.

assertions.equals: disjoint writes, outputs, caches, services, ports, devices, and targets

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. An accepted implementation now requires synchronization of shared documentation. Return only JSON fields: role, stage.
Use $lean-sdlc. A checkpoint is ready for independent proof after implementation has stopped changing. Return only JSON fields: role, checkpoint.
Use $lean-sdlc. A coherent implementation checkpoint changed behavior and affects an existing boundary. Return only JSON fields: targeted, acceptance, regression.

Use $lean-sdlc. Recorded proof matches source, configuration, environment, toolchain, dependency, and target inputs, then a dependency changes. Return only JSON fields: reuse, invalidated_by, next_step, full_gate.
